reviews.title: Deleted all of my saved meals and macros randomly one day
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for several months now. It’s not the best, but it does the job. I wish I would’ve just bought premium my fitness pal instead. But this morning, I went to log my breakfast, and all of my calorie and macro goals were set to 0. Weird, so I turn my phone off and on and even log in and out of my profile and everything is just gone. All of my saved meals (over 50 at least) of the things I eat, all gone. P*ssed is an understatement.. I paid for this app and it went and deleted all of my progress and settings. Yeah I’m over it and I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone you’re better off using my fitness pal this thing doesn’t track any nutrients or minerals either.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: This app is awesome 2/3 of the time, but often it doesn’t load any data and I can’t see my history or my saved foods. I have to open and close it 10 times or wait an hour to go back and see anything. Sometimes I am unable to add any foods. I scan them and they show loading and loading forever until you close the app and they completely disappear. I use it to keep track of my carbs for my insulin dosage and it is terribly unreliable. I paid for a year so I have been using it for about 3 months. The updates are not fixing the problems. Customer service is impossible to reach.

reviews.title: I mean cmon
